purpose: Teach: 下っ/膨らま/別物/呼べる/挙動/利き/積もっ/引き込ま

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんの会社、ぼくの父は下っ端だって言ってた。
lines.en: Mom, Dad said Grandpa's company is where he's kind of… at the bottom.
lines.style: Quiet, hesitant. Sho is working through something he heard and doesn't quite understand. No urgency — almost thinking out loud. Gentle questioning lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お餅、レンジで膨らませて、おやつに。
lines.en: Yes. Let's puff the mochi in the microwave and have it for snack.
lines.style: Warm, practical pivot. Not dismissing what Sho said — acknowledging and gently redirecting. The tone of a mother who's already thinking about the next thing. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 同じ犬の絵本でも、内容、別物だよ。
lines.en: Even if the picture books both have dogs, the stories are totally different.
lines.style: Small but certain. Sho's observation suddenly sharpens — he's noticed something real. Slight emphasis on 「別物」. The voice of a child who's actually paid attention. Not bragging, just noticing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お友達、呼べる時、呼んでね、家に。
lines.en: When your friends can come over, just invite them here, okay?
lines.style: Soft, opening-up tone. Yumiko offering permission and space, not instruction. Warm but leaving room. The gentleness of saying: you're allowed to have people here.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 子犬、急に挙動、不審だよ。
lines.en: The puppy's behavior just changed really suddenly — something's off about it.
lines.style: Low, observant worry. Sho catches something that matters. Not alarmed, but noticing. The quietness of a child realizing something isn't right. Trailing thought, like he's still figuring it out.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、右利き、左手で書くと、不思議な字、書く。
lines.en: Dad's right-handed, but when he writes with his left hand, his letters come out so strange.
lines.style: Dry, fond amusement. Yumiko's wry — she's noticed this and finds it charming. Not mocking. The tone of someone observing something small and real about someone she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 雪、たくさん積もったね、庭に。
lines.en: A lot of snow piled up in the garden, didn't it?
lines.style: Bright, present, noticing something lovely. Sho's voice opens up — he's seeing something that delights him. Simple, direct observation. A little wonder in it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おはなしに、つい引き込まれちゃう、可愛い我が子。
lines.en: You got so drawn into the story, my sweet one.
lines.style: Close, tender, watching. Yumiko's voice is warm and present — she's been observing Sho while he was absorbed. Not performing, just noticing and loving. Low, intimate register.
